name: Raita-Crema (cooling sauce)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
shelf_life_note: 3-4 days at ≤ 5 °C (ASSUMPTION: set by a food-safety professional)
method: Roast garlic cloves until soft (about 160 °C, 20-25 min), cool, mash.
Whisk yogurt and crema smooth; fold in garlic, toasted cumin, lime juice, mint and salt.
Rest 30 min under refrigeration, taste and adjust salt/acid, hold at or below 5 °C.

sauce_spec.use: dip and cooler for every hot dish (Heat architecture level 1)

food_safety: Keep at or below 5 °C (41 °F); date-mark ready-to-eat TCS food and discard on the day the local rule requires (the US Food Code default is 7 days; the kitchen's written policy governs).
Clean spoon for each portion; never top up an open container with fresh sauce.
estimates_label: All quantities, yields and shelf-life values are preliminary estimates until tested by a person in a kitchen.
